versions.content: In case a EthIfSwitchPortGroup is not connected to any EthIfController, the EthIf shall indicate the accumulated link state of the EthIfSwitchPortGroup to the BswM by calling BswM_EthIf_PortGroupLinkStateChg for the EthIfSwitchPortGr oup when the link state changes (refer to SWS_EthIf_ 00259 for link state accumulation).
